verses.text: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
words: until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
words: upon us: for we are exceedingly

verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
words: of those that are at ease,
